question: How should `/reasoning stream` appear in the TUI for issue #42276: transient chat preview, footer/status text, or no live raw stream beyond Show Thinking/history?
rationale: Source evidence proves the stream value and thinking events exist, but the reporter asked for OpenAI/Grok-style rewriting and later footer placement, while upstream Codex distinguishes summary display from raw reasoning; automation should not choose that UX/privacy contract.

options.title: Transient Chat Preview
options.body: Render `stream: "thinking"` as a temporary updating chat entry during the run, then clear, collapse, or replace it when final answer text arrives.

options.title: Footer Status Preview
options.body: Show the latest reasoning summary or delta in the running footer/status line, matching the follow-up request but competing with existing activity and watchdog state.

options.title: History Only
options.body: Do not add live raw TUI reasoning presentation; align help/docs so users rely on `/reasoning on` plus Show Thinking for durable reasoning visibility.

recommendation.title: Transient Chat Preview
recommendation.body: Render `stream: "thinking"` as a temporary updating chat entry during the run, then clear, collapse, or replace it when final answer text arrives.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced `/reasoning` visibility across the current command/docs surface and is the strongest history-backed owner for the TUI UX decision.
